title: Software Engineer II, Fullstack (Ads Platform)
description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.
  
  
Our Marketplace is continually evolving to deliver a deeply personalized shopping experience that seamlessly links consumers with merchant partners. By leveraging machine learning alongside rich consumer and merchant data, we aim to simplify and streamline the customer journey around everyday and major purchases with tailored brands, products, deals, and offers. In tandem, we are advancing our Ads Platform which is a key technology that empowers merchant partners to strategically deploy their budgets and reach targeted consumers for maximum incremental impact.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* With the support of your team’s tech lead and manager, you will break down larger projects into individual tasks, deliver them in multiple phases, and collaborate with others to ensure timely delivery of your work.
* You will support your peers and stakeholders in the product development lifecycle by collaborating with product management, design & analytics by participating in ideation, articulating technical constraints, and partnering on decisions that properly consider risks and trade-offs.
* You will support the operations and availability of your team’s artifacts by creating and monitoring metrics, escalating when needed, and supporting “keep the lights on” & on-call efforts.
* You will contribute to a sense of community on your team by engaging in growth and development activities such as participation in the interview process.

**What We Look For**

* You have a total of 1.5+ years of experience as a software engineer.
* You have experience shipping web apps using declarative UI frameworks like React.
* You have experience designing, developing and launching APIs at scale using languages like Python or Kotlin.
* You have mastered taking a simple problem or business scenario into a solution that interacts with multiple software components, and executing on it by writing clear, easily understood, well tested and extensible code.
* You are comfortable navigating a large code base, debugging others' code, and providing feedback to other engineers through code reviews.
* Your experience demonstrates that you take ownership of your growth, proactively seeking feedback from your team, your manager, and your stakeholders.
* You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team.
* This position requires either equivalent practical experience or a Bachelor’s degree in a related field.

**Base Pay Grade**
- L
  
  
**Equity Grade**
- 6
  
  
Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.
  
  
Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)
  
  
**USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year:**
$165,000 - $225,000
  
  
**USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year:**
$146,000 - $206,000
  
  
**Remote-first with flexibility built in**
Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.
  
  
**Benefits Designed For You**
Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:
  
  

* Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
* Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
* Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
* Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.

We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.
  
  
For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.

description:
About Us

Ivanti empowers organisations to manage and secure technology smarter through our AI‑powered Ivanti Neurons platform. We help IT and Security teams reduce complexity, work proactively, and deliver better outcomes at scale for customers around the world.

Ivanti helps organisations work smarter through Autonomous Endpoint Management powered by our AI‑driven Ivanti Neurons platform—delivering better outcomes for our customers by reducing complexity and enabling proactive IT and security operations.

Role mission

Build, optimize, and scale the digital experiences that help customers discover, evaluate, and engage with Ivanti.

As a Full Stack Web Developer, you’ll turn marketing strategy and creative ideas into fast, secure, accessible, and high-performing web experiences used across Ivanti’s global digital presence.

What to expect

We’re looking for a hands-on Full Stack Web Developer with strong front-end expertise to help evolve ivanti.com and the digital experiences that support our customers throughout their journey.

You’ll work across the full web stack, from polished front-end experiences and interactive content to C#/.NET applications, CMS functionality, APIs, SQL Server, integrations, and deployment pipelines.

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys building things that people actually see and use, while also being comfortable getting under the hood to solve complex technical problems. You’ll partner closely with Creative and Marketing teams and have the autonomy to take work from concept and implementation through launch and production support.

You don’t need to come from a perfectly modern tech stack. We’re looking for someone who can work pragmatically across established, legacy, and modern technologies while helping us continuously improve how we build for the web.

What you’ll do

* **Build experiences:**
  Develop responsive, accessible, high-quality website experiences using C#, ASP.NET, MVC, Razor, JavaScript, HTML, CSS/SCSS, APIs, and SQL Server.
* **Bring creative ideas to life:**
  Partner closely with Creative to turn approved designs into polished, responsive, cross-browser experiences.
* **Create reusable solutions:**
  Build components, templates, campaign pages, interactive tools, and major website experiences that scale beyond one-off projects.
* **Develop rich interactions:**
  Create engaging web experiences using JavaScript and GSAP, including responsive animations and scroll-based interactions.
* **Own the full web stack:**
  Work across CMS configuration, application code, APIs, databases, forms, integrations, routing, caching, redirects, and third-party services.
* **Support our digital ecosystem:**
  Help integrate analytics, Google Tag Manager, browser data layers, consent and privacy tooling, and other marketing technologies.
* **Ship confidently:**
  Contribute to Git-based development, code reviews, Azure DevOps pipelines, testing, releases, launches, and production support.
* **Solve complex problems:**
  Diagnose issues across front-end code, .NET applications, databases, APIs, IIS, Azure services, Cloudflare, caching, integrations, and traffic routing.
* **Own your work:**
  Take projects from investigation and estimation through implementation, testing, deployment, and production support, communicating risks and dependencies along the way.
* **Build smarter with AI:**
  Use tools such as GitHub Copilot to accelerate development, debugging, documentation, refactoring, and code review while ensuring quality, security, performance, and maintainability.

We’re looking for someone who combines strong web development fundamentals with curiosity, ownership, and a practical approach to solving problems.

* Professional experience building and supporting production websites or web applications in a full-stack development role.
* Strong experience with C#, ASP.NET, ASP.NET MVC, Razor, JavaScript, HTML, CSS/SCSS, and SQL Server.
* Strong front-end skills, particularly responsive development, accessibility, cross-browser compatibility, and translating designs accurately into code.
* Experience working with a CMS or content-managed website environment. Experience with Kentico Xperience is a plus.
* Confidence working across multiple layers of a web application, from CMS configuration and browser code through APIs, application logic, and databases.
* Experience with APIs, integrations, forms, HTTP behavior, caching, Git, deployment pipelines, and production releases.
* Strong debugging and problem-solving skills, including the ability to get up to speed quickly with unfamiliar systems.
* Clear communication skills and the ability to explain technical considerations and trade-offs to non-technical partners.
* Experience using GitHub Copilot or another AI coding assistant as part of a professional development workflow.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to have

You don’t need to check every box, but experience in any of the following would be valuable:

* ASP.NET Web Forms
* Kentico Xperience 13 or Xperience by Kentico
* Vue, Nuxt or TypeScript
* Tailwind CSS, jQuery, vanilla JavaScript or GSAP
* Visual Studio, Visual Studio Code and GitHub
* Azure DevOps, IIS, Azure Functions or Azure Storage
* Cloudflare, CDN configuration, caching or traffic routing
* Technical SEO, website performance and accessibility
* Consent management, analytics or tag management
* B2B, enterprise technology or marketing-focused websites

The corporate website sits at the center of Ivanti’s digital presence, connecting customers with our products, content, campaigns, and brand.

In this role, you’ll help us move faster, build better experiences, and strengthen the technical foundation behind our digital marketing ecosystem. Your work will improve website performance and reliability, expand reusable capabilities for Marketing, and help us deliver secure, accessible, engaging experiences at scale.

* Master’s degree in computer science and worked at a company for 5+ years with web technology stack and web standards.

OR

* Proven track record for architecting, scaling and implementing complex technical solutions.

title: Sr. Software Development Engineer
description:
Jiffy.com is seeking a Sr. Software Development Engineer with deep hands-on experience orchestrating AI coding agents to ship production software at pace. Reporting directly to an Engineering Manager and working closely with Product, GM's and other cross functional teams, you will lead the charge on delivering end-to-end features across our e-commerce platform from storefront and checkout to internal tools and platform services while running multiple AI-driven work streams in parallel.
  
  
At Jiffy, engineers no longer write code by hand: every line that reaches production is produced, tested, reviewed, and deployed by coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) under the direction of a human orchestrator. This role is perfect for an individual contributor who has already internalized the shift from "typing code" to "directing agents," has strong architectural taste and review instincts, and wants to help define what an AI-native engineering org looks like. You will thrive here if you are a systems thinker, a builder by nature, and someone who gets more done by managing five parallel agents well than by writing a single function perfectly.
  
  
**At this time, Jiffy is not able to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa (e.g., H-1B) for this position. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship, now or in the future.**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Orchestrate AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) across 3-6 concurrent work streams spanning features, refactors, bug fixes, and investigations using worktrees, sub-agents, and background tasks to maximize parallel throughput
* Own features end-to-end: translate product intent into clear specifications, decompose work into agent-executable plans, drive agents through implementation, review every diff critically, run QA, land PRs, and verify production health
* Design and architect scalable, reliable systems across our stack Rails 8 / Solidus e-commerce, GraphQL APIs, React 19 front end, Kubernetes infrastructure holding the architectural and judgment calls that agents cannot make
* Raise the quality bar on AI-generated code by catching hallucinated APIs, enforcing secure and idiomatic patterns, and pushing back on output that is technically working but structurally wrong
* Build and evolve Jiffy's internal AI tooling: author skills, rules, prompts, MCP integrations, and evaluation harnesses that make the whole engineering org faster. Contribute to our shared .ai/ skills and rules library
* Operate with production rigor: drive agents to produce meaningful test coverage (RSpec, Vitest, Playwright), monitor deploys, respond to incidents, and fully own the services you ship
* Partner cross-functionally with Product, Design, Ops, and peer engineering teams to define and ship features; participate in architecture and code reviews; mentor engineers on AI-native workflows and orchestration patterns
* Continuously identify where remaining manual work (QA, ops runbooks, data investigations, migrations) can be replaced by agents, and automate it

**Requirements**
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
* 5+ years of professional software engineering experience shipping production systems at scale
* Hands-on experience using AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or equivalent) as a primary development tool. This is mandatory. You must be able to walk through real features, refactors, or investigations delivered through agent orchestration — not occasional autocomplete usage
* Proven ability to run multiple agents in parallel and manage concurrent work streams without losing quality, context, or accountability
* Strong software design fundamentals: OO design, API design, data modeling, distributed-system reliability, and performance
* Proficiency in at least one server-side language (Ruby, Python, Go, Java, or equivalent) and one modern front-end stack (React / TypeScript or equivalent), with the expectation that agents produce the code while you direct, review, and validate it
* Experience with relational databases (Postgres / MySQL), SQL, and building or consuming REST or GraphQL APIs
* Elite code-review skills: the ability to read, critique, and correct diffs at speed is the core competency of an AI-first engineer
* Strong written communication — clear intent, clear PR descriptions, clear prompts. In an AI-first org, writing is the programming interface
* A high level of integrity, accountability, and ownership, with a commitment to excellence across every deliverable
* Desire to work in a fast-paced, ambiguous, high-autonomy environment

**Preferred Qualifications**

* AI Tooling Builder: Experience authoring or extending AI developer tooling — custom skills, slash commands, MCP servers, sub-agents, evaluation harnesses, or prompt libraries used by a team
* E-commerce Depth: Experience with Ruby on Rails and Solidus / Spree, or other large-scale e-commerce platforms
* Modern Front End: Experience with React 19, TypeScript, GraphQL (Apollo), Tailwind, and modern state management (React Query, XState, Jotai)
* Cloud Native Operations: Experience operating services on Kubernetes (Istio, KEDA, Flagger) and modern observability stacks
* Automated QA at Scale: Experience driving agents to maintain and extend test suites with Playwright, Vitest, and RSpec
* AI-Native Leadership: Track record of mentoring engineers on AI-native workflows, publishing internal patterns, or leading an organization through the shift away from manual coding
* Measurable Throughput Gains: Documented improvements in features-per-week, cycle time, or review time directly attributable to AI adoption
* High-Growth Environment: Experience shipping in a fast-paced, agile environment at a high-growth startup or tech company

**Benefits**
**What We Offer**
The base compensation for this role is expected to range from $195,000 - $265,000 per year. Actual compensation will be based on a variety of factors, including skills, experience, qualifications, and overall fit for the role.
  
  
Total compensation may include base salary, performance-based bonuses, equity, and benefits. Final offers are tailored to each candidate and take into consideration their background and years of experience.
  
  

* Comprehensive Benefits: Full medical, dental, and vision coverage, with a portion of premiums paid by Jiffy
* Retirement Planning: 401(k)
* Wellness Support: Annual wellness benefits to help you stay healthy and balanced
* Tools for Success: Choice of MacBook or PC laptop, plus equipment for your home office setup
* Perks & Extras: Annual credit of $200 to use on our website plus more team merch drops than you will know what to do with!
* Professional Development: Annual stipend to support your learning and career growth

**EEO**
Jiffy is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. Jiffy considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

title: Frontend Engineer - Top Secret
description:

Our partner is looking for a Frontend Engineer - Top Secret based in United States.**This role offers the opportunity to build next-generation frontend applications supporting critical defense and national security missions. You will create responsive, intuitive interfaces that turn complex operational data into clear, actionable experiences. The work spans real-time data, large geospatial datasets, interactive 2D and 3D maps, and mission-focused visualizations. You will help shape frontend architecture using React, TypeScript, and modern engineering practices. Performance, security, reliability, and usability will be central to the solutions you build and improve. You will collaborate closely with designers, product owners, backend engineers, systems engineers, and mission users. This is a high-impact environment where your technical expertise contributes directly to software supporting critical national missions.
  
Accountabilities
  

* Help define and evolve the architecture of complex frontend applications using React, TypeScript, and modern state-management patterns.
* Build reusable, maintainable interfaces for real-time data analysis, visualization, and mission-focused workflows.
* Develop high-performance 2D and 3D mapping and visualization capabilities using technologies such as OpenLayers, CesiumJS, WebGL, or comparable frameworks.
* Create interfaces capable of handling substantial geospatial datasets, real-time feeds, multiple map layers, and other data-intensive workloads.
* Diagnose and optimize frontend performance, including rendering, memory consumption, network activity, and application responsiveness, particularly on hardware-constrained systems.
* Apply asynchronous programming, web workers, and efficient data-processing techniques to support demanding visualization and analytical workflows.
* Integrate APIs, cloud-native services, authentication mechanisms, and secure data pipelines in partnership with backend and DevOps teams.
* Collaborate with UX/UI designers, product owners, systems engineers, and mission users to deliver intuitive and effective user experiences.
* Write maintainable, well-tested code; participate in technical design discussions and code reviews; and promote frontend engineering standards.
* Evaluate technologies and identify opportunities to improve the application platform and overall engineering practices.
* Mentor junior and mid-level engineers and contribute to a collaborative, high-performing technical culture.

**Requirements**

* U.S. citizenship and an active Top Secret security clearance are required.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, plus 5+ years of professional software engineering experience with significant frontend development; additional experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
* Significant professional experience building frontend applications with React and TypeScript.
* Strong knowledge of modern JavaScript, including ES6+, asynchronous programming, and contemporary frontend development practices.
* Experience designing and implementing reusable, maintainable user interface components.
* Experience working with geospatial data, mapping technologies, or data visualization, including technologies such as GeoJSON, KML, raster or vector tiles, coordinate reference systems, geospatial APIs, OpenLayers, CesiumJS, MapLibre, Mapbox, or comparable tools.
* Demonstrated ability to diagnose and improve browser performance, including rendering, memory usage, network activity, and application responsiveness.
* Experience developing automated tests with tools such as Jest, Cypress, Playwright, or comparable frameworks.
* Strong communication, collaboration, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work effectively in a mission-focused engineering environment.
* Experience with secure or regulated cloud environments, including AWS GovCloud, is preferred.
* Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud-native application deployment is preferred.
* Knowledge of DoD cybersecurity or compliance requirements, including applicable Impact Level requirements, is a plus.
* Experience with 2D/3D geospatial visualization using CesiumJS, Three.js, WebGL, or related technologies is desirable.
* Experience with custom WebGL shaders, GPU-accelerated visualization, real-time or streaming data, geospatial databases, spatial analysis, or geospatial web services is advantageous.
* Experience mentoring engineers or leading frontend technical initiatives is a plus.

**Benefits**

* Annual salary range of $103,500–$181,100, depending on qualifications, experience, and other relevant factors.
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance.
* Paid time off and company holidays.
* 401(k) retirement benefits.
* Life insurance.
* Flexible work schedules.
* Opportunities for professional growth, technical development, and career advancement.
* Remote work environment within the United States.
* Opportunity to contribute to high-impact defense, security, intelligence, and national mission programs.
* A collaborative engineering culture focused on innovation, technical excellence, and meaningful mission outcomes.
* This position requires an active Top Secret clearance and U.S. citizenship.

title: Data & AI Engineer - (Hybrid)
description:
Cruise Planners is the largest franchisor of home-based travel agencies across the country that independently book cruises, tour, and land vacations. Cruise Planners has achieved Top Producer status with virtually every cruise line, tour, and resort company. Cruise Planners has been named the No.1 Cruise Tour / Travel Agency by Entrepreneur Magazine for the past 10 years and recently featured in Entrepreneur as one of the top 30 franchise innovators in technology. Cruise Planners positions franchise owners for success by providing them with innovative marketing, booking and lead-generating tools as well as professional development and hands-on training with the industry’s top executives. Cruise Planners Home Office has won awards such as Coolest Offices and Top Places to Work in South Florida by Sun Sentinel and South Florida Business Journal.
  
  

* Candidates must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the United States. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa\\*\\*

**Job Summary**
The Data & AI Engineer designs, builds, and operates the data and AI systems behind Cruise Planners' analytics, advisor-facing products, and internal automation. The role combines production data engineering on AWS (Glue, Redshift, Step Functions, Lambda, S3) with applied generative-AI work on Amazon Bedrock (Data Automation, Knowledge Bases, AgentCore) and the Strands Agents SDK.
  
  
Day-to-day development is conducted through agentic coding tooling — Claude Code with MCP — used as a primary engineering surface, not as autocomplete, with the pace and scope of delivery expected to exceed what traditional tooling supports. The team is small: engineers scope, build, deploy, document, and operate their own work end to end.
  
  
**The items listed below are intended to provide an overview of the essential functions of the job. This is not an exhaustive list of all functions and responsibilities that the position may be required to perform.**

**Responsibilities**

* Design and operate data pipelines on AWS — Glue, Step Functions, Lambda, EventBridge, S3 — feeding the Redshift data warehouse.
* Stand up and operate containerized production pipelines on AWS Fargate / ECS (scheduled ingest or scrape, enrich, deliver) with CloudWatch alarms and health monitoring.
* Design dimensional data models — facts, conformed dimensions, and analytics marts — on Redshift over a zero-ETL replica of the operational source.
* Implement document-extraction pipelines using Amazon Bedrock Data Automation blueprints and deliver structured output to downstream consumers via webhook or queue.
* Build and operate Bedrock Knowledge Bases for retrieval-augmented generation: source preparation, indexing, retrieval evaluation, and cost / latency tuning.
* Build agents using the Strands Agents SDK on Bedrock AgentCore — supervisor / sub-agent topologies, tool definitions, and deployment hardening.
* Build applied-LLM data products for reporting, search, and agentic operations.
* Deploy and operate services on AWS end to end, including internal web apps and demos.
* Build internal tooling and integrations, including MCP servers.
* Prototype and ship new AI-powered applications for advisors and internal teams.
* Maintain operational quality — logs, alarms, runbooks, on-call response, post-incident notes — and continuously monitor quality and compliance with data-privacy regulations.
* Conduct day-to-day development through Claude Code with project-scoped MCP servers, document decisions and architectures in the team wiki.

****Competencies****
****Technical (builds with)****

* AWS data and serverless services.
* Amazon Bedrock and AgentCore Runtime.
* Python (primary); SQL (baseline).
* Data warehousing and dimensional modeling.
* Agent and LLM frameworks.
* Infrastructure-as-code.

****Tooling (works with)****

* Claude Code as the primary development surface, including parallel sessions.
* MCP servers (AWS, Excolo, Atlassian) as deterministic tool routing for work that previously spanned terminal, IDE, and browser.
* Comfort treating the model as a collaborator — generating alternatives, having design conversations, validating choices before committing — rather than as autocomplete.

****General****

* Writes documentation a teammate can pick up and act on without a meeting.
* Explains trade-offs in plain language to non-engineers (Marketing, Operations, Finance).
* Strong problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Engineering, or a related field. Master's preferred at the Senior level.
* Relevant production experience scaled to level (Data & AI Engineer I / II / Senior).
* Authorization to work in the United States without sponsorship.

****Levels****
Placement is by experience, evidenced output, and judgment scope — not by years alone.
  
  

* Data & AI Engineer I — Executes scoped work end to end under guidance; ships well-defined pipelines, blueprints, or Knowledge Base load jobs.
* Data & AI Engineer II — Owns workstreams end to end (design, build, deploy, operate) and makes architecture choices within an established pattern; writes the playbook a peer can ship from.
* Senior Data & AI Engineer — Owns multi-system architecture; stands up a new pattern (e.g., AgentCore deployment, multi-agent topology) without precedent; coaches peers; represents the team in cross-functional design. Operates across the full stack — Fargate production pipelines, inbound AWS deployments, applied-LLM data products, and end-to-end agent architecture.

****This is a hybrid role (Remote: Mondays and Fridays, Onsite: Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays)****

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment.**

title: Backend Software Engineer II- Data Platform
description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Backend Software Engineer II – Data Platform based in the United States.**This role will help build the data platform that powers critical healthcare products and business operations. You will develop backend services that transform data from health plans, employers, and other partners into reliable, usable information. Your work will support core domains including member identity, eligibility, billing, integrations, reporting, and analytics. Working primarily with Python, you will take features from design through production while developing deeper ownership of services and technical decisions. You will solve challenging problems involving incomplete, duplicated, delayed, and inconsistent real-world data. The role offers the opportunity to strengthen the reliability, scalability, observability, and performance of data-intensive systems in a mission-driven environment. This is a strong opportunity for a backend engineer who enjoys practical problem-solving, distributed systems, and building dependable data infrastructure.
  
**Accountabilities**

* Build and maintain backend services that ingest, validate, reconcile, transform, and serve data received from external partners.
* Develop reliable systems supporting member identity, eligibility, billing, integrations, and other critical business domains.
* Design and implement APIs, asynchronous workflows, and data pipelines used across the organization.
* Build systems capable of handling incomplete, duplicated, delayed, inconsistent, and otherwise imperfect real-world data.
* Implement reliable mechanisms for retrying, replaying, recovering, and reconciling data when processing failures occur.
* Improve the reliability, observability, test coverage, performance, and maintainability of production systems.
* Collaborate with Engineering, Product, and Operations teams to clarify ambiguous requirements and determine effective technical solutions.
* Take features from initial design through implementation, deployment, and production operation.
* Investigate unfamiliar areas of the codebase, understand existing architecture, and make thoughtful improvements without introducing unnecessary complexity.
* Contribute to technical decisions and gradually take greater ownership of backend services and system design.
* Apply strong engineering practices around correctness, validation, idempotency, error handling, retries, and edge cases.
* Support additional engineering initiatives and responsibilities as business and team priorities evolve.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent educational background is required.
* 2+ years of professional experience building and maintaining backend software.
* Strong programming fundamentals, with professional experience in Python preferred.
* Experience working with relational databases and SQL.
* Experience developing systems that process, transform, or move significant volumes of data.
* Solid understanding of software testing, debugging, API design, and common distributed-system failure modes.
* Experience deploying or operating applications in a cloud environment.
* Strong instincts around system correctness, including data validation, idempotency, retries, recovery, and edge-case handling.
* Ability to quickly understand an unfamiliar codebase and improve it while maintaining simplicity and reliability.
* Strong written communication skills and the ability to clearly explain technical decisions, tradeoffs, and approaches.
* Experience with data-intensive backend systems, ETL/ELT pipelines, or event-driven architectures is preferred.
* Familiarity with PostgreSQL, analytical data warehouses, or data modeling is an advantage.
* Experience with infrastructure as code, containers, or workflow orchestration is a plus.
* Exposure to identity resolution, entity matching, eligibility, claims, healthcare data, or other complex data domains is beneficial.
* Experience working in regulated or security-sensitive production environments is desirable.
* Previous healthcare experience is not required, and candidates do not need experience with every technology used by the organization.
* Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States; work visa sponsorship is not available.
* Employees must reside in and work from the United States, subject to applicable employment eligibility requirements.

**Benefits**

* Annual salary range of $120,000–$130,000.
* Fully remote position within the United States.
* Opportunity to work on backend and data infrastructure supporting meaningful healthcare outcomes.
* Exposure to complex data engineering challenges involving identity, eligibility, billing, partner integrations, and analytics.
* Opportunity to grow from well-defined engineering assignments toward greater ownership of services and technical decisions.
* Collaborative work across Engineering, Product, and Operations teams.
* Opportunity to contribute to reliable, scalable, and security-conscious production systems.
* Inclusive and diverse working environment committed to equal employment opportunities and professional development.

title: Data & AI Engineer - (Hybrid)
description:
Cruise Planners is the largest franchisor of home-based travel agencies across the country that independently book cruises, tour, and land vacations. Cruise Planners has achieved Top Producer status with virtually every cruise line, tour, and resort company. Cruise Planners has been named the No.1 Cruise Tour / Travel Agency by Entrepreneur Magazine for the past 10 years and recently featured in Entrepreneur as one of the top 30 franchise innovators in technology. Cruise Planners positions franchise owners for success by providing them with innovative marketing, booking and lead-generating tools as well as professional development and hands-on training with the industry’s top executives. Cruise Planners Home Office has won awards such as Coolest Offices and Top Places to Work in South Florida by Sun Sentinel and South Florida Business Journal.

***\\*\\******Candidates must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the United States. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa*****\\*\\****

**Job Summary**

The Data & AI Engineer designs, builds, and operates the data and AI systems behind Cruise Planners' analytics, advisor-facing products, and internal automation. The role combines production data engineering on AWS (Glue, Redshift, Step Functions, Lambda, S3) with applied generative-AI work on Amazon Bedrock (Data Automation, Knowledge Bases, AgentCore) and the Strands Agents SDK.

Day-to-day development is conducted through agentic coding tooling — Claude Code with MCP — used as a primary engineering surface, not as autocomplete, with the pace and scope of delivery expected to exceed what traditional tooling supports. The team is small: engineers scope, build, deploy, document, and operate their own work end to end.

*The items listed below are intended to provide an overview of the essential functions of the job. This is not an exhaustive list of all functions and responsibilities that the position may be required to perform.*

**Responsibilities**

* Design and operate data pipelines on AWS — Glue, Step Functions, Lambda, EventBridge, S3 — feeding the Redshift data warehouse.
* Stand up and operate containerized production pipelines on AWS Fargate / ECS (scheduled ingest or scrape, enrich, deliver) with CloudWatch alarms and health monitoring.
* Design dimensional data models — facts, conformed dimensions, and analytics marts — on Redshift over a zero-ETL replica of the operational source.
* Implement document-extraction pipelines using Amazon Bedrock Data Automation blueprints and deliver structured output to downstream consumers via webhook or queue.
* Build and operate Bedrock Knowledge Bases for retrieval-augmented generation: source preparation, indexing, retrieval evaluation, and cost / latency tuning.
* Build agents using the Strands Agents SDK on Bedrock AgentCore — supervisor / sub-agent topologies, tool definitions, and deployment hardening.
* Build applied-LLM data products for reporting, search, and agentic operations.
* Deploy and operate services on AWS end to end, including internal web apps and demos.
* Build internal tooling and integrations, including MCP servers.
* Prototype and ship new AI-powered applications for advisors and internal teams.
* Maintain operational quality — logs, alarms, runbooks, on-call response, post-incident notes — and continuously monitor quality and compliance with data-privacy regulations.
* Conduct day-to-day development through Claude Code with project-scoped MCP servers, document decisions and architectures in the team wiki.

**Competencies**

**Technical (builds with)**

* AWS data and serverless services.
* Amazon Bedrock and AgentCore Runtime.
* Python (primary); SQL (baseline).
* Data warehousing and dimensional modeling.
* Agent and LLM frameworks.
* Infrastructure-as-code.

**Tooling (works with)**

* Claude Code as the primary development surface, including parallel sessions.
* MCP servers (AWS, Excolo, Atlassian) as deterministic tool routing for work that previously spanned terminal, IDE, and browser.
* Comfort treating the model as a collaborator — generating alternatives, having design conversations, validating choices before committing — rather than as autocomplete.

**General**

* Writes documentation a teammate can pick up and act on without a meeting.
* Explains trade-offs in plain language to non-engineers (Marketing, Operations, Finance).
* Strong problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Engineering, or a related field. Master's preferred at the Senior level.
* Relevant production experience scaled to level (Data & AI Engineer I / II / Senior).
* Authorization to work in the United States without sponsorship.

**Levels**

Placement is by experience, evidenced output, and judgment scope — not by years alone.

* **Data & AI Engineer I** — Executes scoped work end to end under guidance; ships well-defined pipelines, blueprints, or Knowledge Base load jobs.
* **Data & AI Engineer II** — Owns workstreams end to end (design, build, deploy, operate) and makes architecture choices within an established pattern; writes the playbook a peer can ship from.
* **Senior Data & AI Engineer** — Owns multi-system architecture; stands up a new pattern (e.g., AgentCore deployment, multi-agent topology) without precedent; coaches peers; represents the team in cross-functional design. Operates across the full stack — Fargate production pipelines, inbound AWS deployments, applied-LLM data products, and end-to-end agent architecture.

**This is a hybrid role (Remote: Mondays and Fridays, Onsite: Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays)**

Cruise Planners complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities or team members. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment.*

title: Founding Engineer
description:
**About Us**

Prestige Trucking Insurance is a commercial trucking insurance agency specializing in fleets. We also own Insure Stack, an AI native operating system for insurance distribution serving 800+ agencies. Insure Stack automates commercial trucking and commercial auto quoting by working carrier portals and APIs in parallel, with one goal: quotes from every carrier, at the same time, in under ten seconds. The platform originated at a Y Combinator company.

Because Insure Stack lives inside an operating agency, you build right next to the people who quote trucking risks every day, and you see the impact of your work immediately.

**The Role**

We are looking for a builder who wants to take this product to the next level. You will own the platform end to end, work directly with leadership, and help decide where our technology goes next. You will be measured on growth and revenue as much as on code, and the scope of this role grows with the company.

**What You’ll Do**

* Own the core quoting engine and carrier automation layer, keeping it reliable and fast as we add carriers and volume
* Ship features that grow the business: new carriers, better conversion, faster quotes, new revenue streams
* Design and ship LLM pipelines that read submissions, extract risk data, and normalize quotes across carriers
* Build full stack in Python and Next.js, from database to UI
* Bring ideas to leadership on product, pricing, and growth, not just estimates
* Set the engineering standards and culture as the team grows

**Who You Are**

* **You Think Like a Business Owner.**
  Every technical decision comes back to revenue, cost, and customers. You look for ways to grow the product and get it into more agencies, and you treat company time and money like your own. You bring opportunities to the table, not just tickets.
* **You See Around Corners, Then Decide.**
  Before you write code, you can tell us: if we build it this way, here is what could break, here is what it costs us later, and here is how long it really takes. You weigh it, make the call, and move. Analysis serves the decision; it never replaces it.
* **You Don’t Overpromise.**
  Your estimates are honest, and you hit them. If something will take longer than leadership hopes, you say so up front, explain why, and offer the best path forward. You would rather commit to a realistic date and beat it than promise a fast one and miss it.
* **You Move Fast and Build It Right.**
  Our leadership moves fast and decides quickly. You keep pace without cutting corners. What you ship is tested, secure, and built to last, because rework is the slowest path of all.
* **You Sweat the Details.**
  In insurance, one wrong VIN, driver, or coverage limit means a bad quote. You catch it before it ships.
* **You Understand Insurance, or Want to Master It.**
  Experience in insurance or insurtech, ideally commercial trucking or commercial auto, is a strong plus. If you are new to the industry, you are eager to learn how submissions, carrier appetite, and agencies really work, and you will have a working agency to learn from.

**Experience**

* A track record as a founding, solo, or early stage engineer
* Strong Python plus Next.js, React, and Node.js
* Hands on Playwright or browser automation in production
* Production LLM experience, including evaluation (Langfuse or similar)
* Clear communicator who explains technical tradeoffs in business terms

**Our Stack**

Python, Next.js, React, Node.js, Playwright, Neon (Postgres), Stripe, Resend, PostHog, Linear, GCP

**Why Join**

* A true founding role with real ownership over architecture and product
* Built inside an operating insurance agency, so you work with real users from day one
* Your work ships to hundreds of agencies
* A big, underserved market with a real problem to solve
